results.name: wheel while mouse reporting is off reaches the terminal, not the app
results.note: 3 wheel-up events with reporting off left the top row unchanged: false. tui-test encodes mouse input as SGR bytes regardless of the DEC private modes the app has set (probe: an app with only ?1049 set still receives \x1b[<64;..M and motion \x1b[<35;..M), so a real terminal's "mouse off => terminal selects/scrolls natively" path cannot be exercised.
